title: Circular reasoning when Scripture's authority hangs on Pope, Church, traditions, and councils
pass_a_gloss: 2. From inconvenience or absurdity. For he who does not rest in our principle either goes round in a circle or begs the principle, after the manner of the Pontificals, who suspend the authority of Scripture from the authority of the Pontiff, of the Church, of traditions and of councils in the order of our cognition, and yet demonstrate these very things from the Scriptures. But what else is this than to be driven round in a circle by their own proofs? They believe that what Scripture teaches is true because the Church or the Pontiff hands it down; and again, they believe that what the Church or the Pontiff hands down is true because Scripture so teaches. This is not a regress but a circle, concerning whose nature see Jacopo Zabarella, Liber 1, preface to the Analytics, controversy 23.
pass_b_english: 2. From inconvenience or absurdity. Refuse our principle and you either circle or beg the question — the papal party's habit. They hang Scripture's authority on Pontiff, Church, traditions, and councils as far as our knowing goes, and then prove those very authorities from the Scriptures. That is nothing but driving their own proofs around a circle.

They hold Scripture true because Church or Pontiff delivers it; then hold Church or Pontiff true because Scripture says so. Call it what you will: it is not a regress. It is a circle. On that circle's nature see Jacopo Zabarella, book 1, preface to the Analytics, controversy 23.
source_text: 2. Ab incommodo seu absurdo. Qui enim in nostro principio non sistit, is in circulum commeat, aut principium petit; more Pontificiorum, qui scripturae authoritatem ab authoritate Pontificis, Ecclesiae, traditionum & conciliorum suspendunt in ordine ad nostram cognitionem, & tamen haec ipsa ex scripturis demonstrant. Quid vero hoc aliud est, quam probationibus suis in circulum circumagi? Credunt verum esse, quod scriptura docet, quia id tradit Ecclesia sive Pontifex: & rursus, credunt, verum esse, quod Ecclesia sive Pontifex tradit, quia ita docet scriptura. Qui non regressus, sed circulus est, de cujus natura vide Jac. Zabarellam L.1.pr.Analyt.cont.23.
